why_ai: Case managers work face to face with people in crisis, and need grows regardless of AI.
why_clarity: Outcomes like improved employment are ill-defined, rarely measured and known years later.
why_digital: Services delivered in person to local clients, with documentation as the only screen work.

why_ai: SNAP, Medicaid and TANF eligibility rules are complex but fully codifiable into screening engines.
why_clarity: Income thresholds and categorical tests give exact, repeatable eligibility determinations.
why_digital: Household facts gathered at intake, screened on screens, delivered locally.

why_ai: Platform workflow and reporting automate, with cross-agency client histories as a modest moat.
why_clarity: Intake, service tracking and funder exports are defined, recurring software functions.
why_digital: Case data in, software and dashboards out, sold to agencies.

why_ai: Statutory triennial cycles sustain demand, but indicator analysis and writing are automatable.
why_clarity: Assessments follow standard formats on fixed cycles, though their impact is slow to judge.
why_digital: Indicator data and community surveys in, reports out, with some in-person engagement.

why_ai: Job seekers get in-person career counselling at job centres, though eligibility tracking automates.
why_clarity: WIOA defines eligibility and performance metrics, but employment outcomes arrive quarters later.
why_digital: Job seekers visit local job centres; services are largely face to face.

why_ai: Perishable food is physically sourced, warehoused and trucked to partner agencies.
why_clarity: Pounds distributed, spoilage and fill rates give clear logistics metrics.
why_digital: Physical food moved through warehouses and trucks to local pantries.

why_ai: Grantee perception survey series carry credibility, though analysis and writing automate.
why_clarity: Annual studies repeat, but effects on grantmaking practice show slowly.
why_digital: Survey data in, published research out, funded remotely.

why_ai: Public officials with authority decide contract renewals and audit findings.
why_clarity: Contract terms and audit standards define checks repeated across providers.
why_digital: Records reviewed digitally with site visits, inside government with no commercial buyer.

why_ai: Federal mandate keeps HMIS running, but its reporting and administration are highly automatable.
why_clarity: HUD data standards define exact reports and performance measures each cycle.
why_digital: Client records in, federal reports out, funded by federal grants only.

why_ai: Coordinated entry and outreach require human judgement with vulnerable people across agencies.
why_clarity: HUD reporting is defined, but prioritisation calls and housing outcomes are slow and contested.
why_digital: Outreach and coordination happen in person within one region.

why_ai: Negotiated rate precedent and agency relationships help, though cost allocation itself is rule-based.
why_clarity: Uniform guidance defines allocation methods, and the negotiated rate is a clear result.
why_digital: Financial records in, rate proposals out, negotiated remotely with agencies.

why_ai: Licensed care managers authorise services and actuaries certify rates under state contracts.
why_clarity: Authorisation criteria and utilisation metrics apply across whole member populations.
why_digital: Claims and authorisations are digital, but care assessments happen in members' homes.

why_ai: A licensed CPA must sign the audit opinion and carries personal liability.
why_clarity: Auditing standards and the compliance supplement codify tests repeated across grantees.
why_digital: Records-based testing with on-site fieldwork, usually by regional firms.

why_ai: Clients hire a former executive director's personal judgement and sector relationships.
why_clarity: Each strategy engagement is bespoke and its results surface years later.
why_digital: Board retreats and meetings are often in person, with clients found through local networks.

why_ai: Structured extraction over public filings is exactly what AI now does cheaply.
why_clarity: Every filing is extracted and classified the same way, checkable against source.
why_digital: Public filings in, data products out, sold online.

why_ai: Evaluation design and fieldwork interviews need methodological judgement AI only assists.
why_clarity: Each study is designed fresh and its validity is judged slowly.
why_digital: Programme data plus interviews in, evaluation reports out.

why_ai: Mentorship and trust with formerly incarcerated people is human relationship work.
why_clarity: Each person's barriers differ and recidivism outcomes take years to see.
why_digital: Paper files and in-person support for clients often without smartphones.

why_ai: Cultural mediation and housing search for new arrivals need people on the ground.
why_clarity: Ninety-day milestones are defined, but every family's path differs.
why_digital: In-person services to arrivals with limited English, delivered locally.

why_ai: Weatherisation, Head Start and transport are delivered in person across vast rural areas.
why_clarity: Programme rules codify eligibility, but outcomes across ten programmes are loosely measured.
why_digital: Paper intake and physical services where connectivity is unreliable.

why_ai: Each pay-for-success deal is novel, multi-party and judged years later.
why_clarity: Payment triggers are defined, but there are only a few dozen deals and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Contracts and evaluation data are digital, negotiated with governments and investors.

why_ai: Local donor trust and decades of provider relationships drive allocation decisions.
why_clarity: Allocation cycles repeat annually, but programme impact is slow and loosely measured.
why_digital: Site visits and local relationships sit alongside digital application review.

why_ai: Mentorship and life-skills coaching for youth without family support depend on human relationships.
why_clarity: Each youth's needs differ and adult outcomes appear years later.
why_digital: Housing and coaching are in person, though youth are digitally fluent.
